text: When a man opens up, when he really opens up, don't you use what he said when he was open to prove a point when you want to win an argument.
You will never hear the full story from us ever again.
And we'll start to say stuff like this.
I ain't good, but i just ain't telling you
women let me tell you something men are not emotionless
we have deep emotions we just don't know how to express them and let me tell you if you make us
feel unsafe you'll never hear from us again If I tell you something in a moment of vulnerability
and you use it against me in an argument,
you can forget me talking to you forever.
And you keep talking about he cried, he shut down,
he's in his man cave, he won't open up
because when he did open up, you shut the door on him.
